Based on my reading of the actual implementation code (`server.js`, `public/app.js`, `public/index.html`), here is my coverage assessment. The implementation ("Trove") is a single-user bookmark app with URL save + metadata fetch (title/description only), labels/tags with autocomplete and filtering, plain full-text search, read-later, and rich-text (not markdown) notes. It lacks delete, sort, bulk actions, boolean/#tag/phrase search, archive, snapshots, bundles, import/export, and settings.

REF-BM-23: notes are WYSIWYG rich-text HTML (contenteditable/execCommand, stored/rendered as sanitized HTML), not markdown. REF-BM-24/25: no page snapshot or PDF handling or Internet Archive support. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archived flag anywhere. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: no user/display settings (sort, items per page, font size)."
